title: Kelpworks
caption:
This farm is under the sea.

KelpWorks grows vast kelp farms on the sea floor and sells kelp as food, fertiliser and bioplastic packaging. That's food and materials grown without any farmland.

Its edge: the biggest sea-floor farms and the know-how to run them. The risks: storms and currents, Abyssal Habitats wanting the same sea floor, and kelp prices.

Find KelpWorks at memestreet.net

narration: This farm is under the sea. Meet KelpWorks, from the deep ocean cities industry on Meme Street's fictional market. It grows vast kelp farms on the sea floor, harvested all year round. It sells kelp as food, as fertiliser for farms on land, and as bioplastic packaging. That means food and materials grown without using any farmland at all. Its edge is the biggest sea floor farms on the market, and the know-how to run them. The risks? Storms and strong currents, Abyssal Habitats wanting the same sea floor, and swings in kelp prices. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Find KelpWorks, at memestreet.net.
